messages:
Ivy (People Ops): Heads up  I'm assembling a compact "start smart" checklist for incoming managers. Need something that fits in an offer packet and also becomes a first-day handout. Please flag missing items.

Noah (Hiring Manager): Sounds great. Can we make it micro-day-by-day? New managers appreciate a timeline (what to do in first 2 hours, first day, first week).

Sam (Eng Manager): Add an ops line if they touch infra: request staging-only RBAC by default, plan prod access path, and include a short note on Redwood Dedicated/GPU quota if relevant.

Ivy (People Ops): OK draft below. Short blocks and action items.

Ivy (People Ops): START SMART: manager micro-plan
- First 2 hours: meet People Ops (paperwork + benefits quick pass), confirm Google/Slack/GitHub access, enable MFA
- First 4 hours: team hello (10m), meet direct reports quick round-robin (5m each), add buddy to calendar
- Before EOD: confirm Redwood Console viewer access request submitted, join #team and #eng channels, set 1-hour focus block tomorrow

Ivy (People Ops): FIRST WEEK: priorities (actionable)
- Schedule 30m 1:1s with each direct report (use 30/60/90 prompts)
- Create and share a 1-slide stakeholder map by day 5 (infra, security, product, recruiting owners)
- Review open PRs / backlog with lead engineer; unblock 2 small tickets
- Verify CI/CD deploy permissions and deploy bot access

Ivy (People Ops): HIRING & BEHAVIOR EXPECTATIONS
- Candidate scorecards submitted within 48h of interview
- Interview debrief within 72h
- Communicate decisions to Recruiting within 24h of panel consensus

Ivy (People Ops): 30/60/90 prompts (manager version)
- 30 days: have met all skip-levels, own team org map, identify 3 immediate blockers and unblock 1
- 60 days: run at least one postmortem or product planning session, recommend a process tweak, complete hiring loop
- 90 days: present a draft Q+1 plan and 2 measurable team KPIs; publish updated IC onboarding checklist

Mira (Security): Security note  prod access requires signed access justification + security review. SSO/KMS owners should be introduced by Day 2.

Sam (Eng Manager): Ops checklist to add to the packet:
- [ ] Staging RBAC granted
- [ ] Prod access request filed if needed
- [ ] Redwood Dedicated quota request (if model workloads)
- [ ] Access to runbooks and oncall rota

Ivy (People Ops): WHO TO ASK (Day 1 shortcuts)
- Onboarding ops: Ivy / Priya (accounts & payroll)
- Infra: Sam / devinfra-team
- Security: Mira
- Recruiting: Noah
- DevRel / SDK: Robin

Noah (Hiring Manager): Also add a micro-template managers can copy to announce the hire in Slack. Keeps onboarding friction low.

Ivy (People Ops): Slack announce template:
"Hi team ", please welcome <Name> joining as <Role> on <Date>. I'll run a 10-15m intro at 10:00 to say hi. Drop a welcome note in #team.

OnboardBot: Checklist template saved to /docs/onboarding/start-smart-manager.md

Ivy (People Ops): One more practical rule: for the first 14 days, cap heavy interview days at 2 interviews and avoid schedule-heavy afternoons (recommend focus block 13:00-14:00). Helps with ramp.

Sam (Eng Manager): Agree. Also recommend scheduling an oncall shadow within the first 10 days for teams that do rotations.

Ivy (People Ops): I'll finalize and export to PDF for offer attachments. Thanks for the quick feedback 44d. If no objections, I'll mark this settled and update the HR checklist flow tonight.
